designSystem.fonts: No web fonts load anywhere: no Google Fonts, no @font-face, no @import. Home headings use the system face 'Segoe UI Variable Display' → Segoe UI → system-ui → -apple-system → Helvetica Neue → Arial (home.css:5), bold 700 with tight negative tracking. Inner pages and the wiki use Georgia for h1-h4 and the brand (site.css:27, :58, :86), and system-ui for body text. The result is two brands: a modern sans on home and an editorial serif elsewhere (compare index-w1440-01.png with community-w1440-01.png). On macOS, iOS and Android the home display face falls back to SF or Roboto, so the tight -.045em tracking was tuned for a font most non-Windows visitors never see. Give every item a status chip (Released / Coming in 0.4.5 / Rolling out) and a group anchor. Add sticky filter chips at the top (All · Released · Coming 0.4.5). Reuse the existing screenshots, one per group

New roadmap.html driven by one data file (e.g. assets/roadmap.json with {title, blurb, status, area, evidence}), so updates do not need HTML edits. Use lanes Done (released, grouped by version: 0.4.4, 0.4.3 …), Being worked on (coming-0.4.5 plus rolling-out: Rooms and Listen together need the hub URL and link app ID), Planned (docs/community.md 'What comes later': Phase 4 cowork rooms with GitHub access, Phase 5 capacity pools; fleet overhaul from docs/fleet-overhaul-plan.md), and Ideas ('Hey Studio' from docs/public-site.md, plus the owner's creator-economy vision). Each card gets a status chip in the token colours (released = --live, coming = --accent, rolling-out = --warn, planned = --info, idea = dashed and --dim, reusing home's .tag styles), a one-line description and an evidence link (CHANGELOG anchor or commit).
